core_meaning.primary_meaning: Hyder is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Lion; brave, bold”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Hyder corresponds to the Arabic form حيدر (Arabic حَيْدَر (Ḥaydar)). Its core sense is lion; brave, bold. Hyder is a variant transliteration of Arabic حَيْدَر (Ḥaydar) 'lion; brave, bold', a well-documented Arabic personal name and an epithet of Ali ibn Abi Talib. The source gloss 'Successor, Guide' is unsupported and has been replaced with the lexical sense. Same name as haydar, hayder and heydar.
